purpose: Teach: 織り/格子/三輪/面影/根強い/坊さん/悔い/実体験

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、本気で、絶対、織り、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku, you definitely learned weaving in home ec, right?
lines.style: Light, direct challenge. Quick tempo. Assumes he remembers. Testing curiosity in her voice—she wants to see if he'll engage.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。学校の窓、本気で、絶対、格子、絶対、リフォームしたんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. We actually renovated the school windows into lattice patterns, remember?
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Speaking to a shared memory he might have forgotten. Measured pace. Slight fondness underneath the cool exterior.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 幼稚園の時、本気で、絶対、三輪車、絶対、お前と、絶対、レース、絶対、したよね、リク
lines.en: In kindergarten we used to race tricycles together, remember?
lines.style: Softer attack. Slower, almost dreamy pacing. Looking backward. Voice trails gently—she's checking if the memory lands the same way for him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、小さい頃の、絶対、面影、絶対、まだ、絶対、残ってるぜ、桜
lines.en: You know, you still have that same look you had as a kid.
lines.style: Warm observation delivered quietly. Not romantic—noticing. Slight pause before the statement, like he's choosing his words carefully. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この街の、本気で、絶対、根強い、絶対、お祭り、絶対、続いてるよね、リク
lines.en: This town really does keep those old festivals going, doesn't it?
lines.style: Brighter again. Animated but grounded. Speaking about something she cares about. Steady rhythm, genuine affection for the place in her tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 近所のお寺の、本気で、絶対、坊さん、絶対、お話、絶対、面白いんだぜ、桜
lines.en: The monk at the temple near my place tells these hilarious stories.
lines.style: Easy, conversational. Like he's sharing something he enjoys. Light pace. A small smile underneath—he's inviting her into something he finds good.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 前回のテスト、本気で、絶対、もっと、絶対、勉強、絶対、しておけば、絶対、よかったって、絶対、悔い、絶対、残ってるよ、リク
lines.en: I still regret not studying harder for that last test.
lines.style: Self-aware wry. Quick-paced confession. Not dwelling—stating it plainly, but with that undercurrent of rueful humor. She's letting him know she's human.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、実体験、絶対、俺、絶対、参考にするぜ、桜
lines.en: Actually, your real experiences help me figure things out.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded. Slightly slower than his usual cool distance. He's admitting something true. Quiet intensity. No performance—just honesty delivered close.
